scenario.restriction: synthetic scenario shape; not target-enterprise approval

process.restriction: proposed synthetic paths; not live observation or user acceptance

semantics.restriction: released synthetic definitions and executable contract checks only

decision.restriction: deterministic synthetic rules and tests only

readOnlyReplay.restriction: named synthetic subject, scenario, source, and fixture access only

controls.queryAndRecommendation: allowed only for the bound synthetic subject, scenario, and source

changeRecord.change: Consolidate the synthetic case narrative and assurance evidence, deepen the replay interface, and remove duplicated rehearsal ceremony.
changeRecord.rollback: Restore the prior example files and replay interface from Git; no enterprise or persistent state requires migration or compensation.

notEvidenceOf: real source, identity, privacy, retention, or telemetry authorization
observed human adoption or persistent feedback
controlled execution or ERP write-back authorization
